'''Kombat''' is a one-day duel tournament played '''Friday 18th February''', 20:00 / 22:00 {{Abbr/CET}} with entries for higher and lower divisions. 
The ambition is to bring more quick and easy tournaments into Quakeworld that doesn't require scheduling for each and every match. 

Sign-up: https://forms.gle/gfDVyS8NFQeFEYpQ6

===Prize pool===
$500 is spread among the players as seen below:

== Format ==
* Separated higher and lower divisions.
* Lower division start at 20:00 {{Abbr/CET}}
* Higher division start at 22:00 {{Abbr/CET}}
* Top players from lower division will move forward to higher division.
* All matches are {{Abbr|BO3|Best of 3}}

== Rules ==
* Map order: cmd rnd for first pick. then p2 pick. p1 toss, p2 toss, remaining map as decider.
* European tournament (other regions are welcome but EU servers are prioritized for lowest ping)
* Client: ezQuake
* Same map can not be played twice.
* Ruleset: smackdown/qcon
* Walkovers given if opponent fail to show 20 min after tournament start.
* Reporting: send screenshots in [http://discord.quake.world/ discord] channel: <mark>#kombat</mark>, or message {{Player|Alice|flag=se}}
